source: Aviation Branch Handbook (Annex A to the Aviation Branch Operations SOP), 15 July 2024, Parts 3 and 4, in the app's own words

takeoffWarningSeconds.label: Lead's warning before takeoff, at least

spOutboundAirspeed.label: Lead departs to the SP at

joinClosureKnots.label: Closure when joining, not more than this above the briefed airspeed

leadChangeTurn.label: Lead's heading change to leave the formation

leadChangeDisks.label: Old lead's separation before it parallels the flight

lostCommoDisksDay.label: Separation while signalling lost commo, day

lostCommoDisksNight.label: Separation while signalling lost commo, night

lostVisualSlow.label: Aircraft that lost visual slows by

lostVisualAltitude.label: Aircraft that lost visual climbs or descends by

linkUpAltitude.label: Vertical separation at a link-up point, at least

iimcClearanceFt.label: Added to the highest terrain or obstacle for the base altitude

iimcAltitudeStep.label: Base altitude adjustment for subsequent chalks

iimcHeadingStep.label: Base heading adjustment, times the chalk number, to the clear side

iimcAirspeedStep.label: Base airspeed less this for subsequent chalks

downedSecurityMeters.label: Wingman's air security around a downed aircraft

downedMoveMeters.label: Crew moves within this of the aircraft if the site is not secure

separationDayDisks.label: Rotor disk separation by day: SP inbound / enroute / RP inbound / landing

separationNightDisks.label: Rotor disk separation at night or on NVG: SP inbound / enroute / RP inbound / landing

redcon1.title: REDCON-1 procedures
redcon1.summary: Anti-collision lights off at REDCON 1 except trail; trail starts the report in reverse chalk order; lead calls the flight REDCON 1, warns at least 5 s ahead and takes off on time.
script: Every aircraft but trail turns its anti-collision light off at REDCON 1.
Trail starts the REDCON 1 report in reverse chalk order; when lead reports REDCON 1 the flight is ready.

Lead warns at least {value:takeoffWarningSeconds} seconds before departure and takes off on time, accelerating to {value:spOutboundAirspeed} knots and climbing at less than {value:departureClimbFpm} feet a minute.
Anyone who cannot make the takeoff time tells lead.

leadChange.title: Lead change procedures
leadChange.summary: Lead calls the side, the flight acknowledges in chalk order; old lead turns out {value:leadChangeTurn}°, opens to {value:leadChangeDisks} disks, slows {value:leadChangeSlow} KIAS and takes trail unless the AMC places it.
script: Lead change: lead calls "lead change" and the side, and the flight acknowledges in chalk order.
Lead turns {value:leadChangeTurn} degrees out of the formation to at least {value:leadChangeDisks} rotor disks, then parallels the flight and slows {value:leadChangeSlow} knots.
Each aircraft calls clear as it passes; the old lead takes trail unless the AMC places it, and trail calls saddled.

lostCommo.title: Lost communication procedures
lostCommo.summary: Show the lost-commo signal until acknowledged; the next aircraft moves where it can be seen at {value:lostCommoDisksDay} disks ({value:lostCommoDisksNight} at night); stay in chalk order; a lead with lost commo hands over the lead.
script: Lost commo: work the PACE plan first.

Still lost, show the lost-commo signal until it is answered with the same signal; the adjacent aircraft moves where it can be seen, at least {value:lostCommoDisksDay} rotor disks by day and {value:lostCommoDisksNight} at night.
Stay in chalk order and in sight of an aircraft that has comms; changes of position are made on the ground.
If lead has lost commo, we change lead once it is acknowledged. The AMC decides whether to continue or abort; an abort flies the briefed return route.

lostVisual.title: Loss of visual contact
lostVisual.summary: Call blind; the aircraft lost gives heading, airspeed, altitude and position from a common point; slow {value:lostVisualSlow} KIAS and move {value:lostVisualAltitude} ft; rejoin at no more than {value:joinClosureKnots} KIAS above. Rally points: {bind:rally.points}.
script: Lost visual: use every digital aid, then call blind on internal.
The aircraft you lost gives its heading, airspeed, MSL altitude, and bearing and distance from a common point, and shows trail lighting.
You slow {value:lostVisualSlow} knots below its airspeed and climb or descend {value:lostVisualAltitude} feet.
Once visual, close at no more than {value:joinClosureKnots} knots above it and call closing; trail calls saddled.
Not visual: continue as two flights in radio contact and link up on the ground at the next landing zone. Rally points are {bind:rally.points}.

actionsOnContact.title: Actions on contact
actionsOnContact.summary: Evade, suppress if able, get to cover or out of contact, develop the situation and decide, and report.
script: Actions on contact: evasive maneuver for the kind of contact, suppress immediately if able and announce it, break contact to cover or out of the threat's reach, then the AMC decides on a course of action and reports.

iimc.title: IIMC
iimc.summary: Base {field:baseAltitude}, heading {field:baseHeading}, airspeed {field:baseAirspeed}; subsequent chalks ±{value:iimcAltitudeStep} ft, {value:iimcHeadingStep}° × chalk to the clear side, less {value:iimcAirspeedStep} KIAS. Recover {field:recovery}.
script: IIMC: announce it with your chalk and heading, go to instruments, never descend.

Base altitude {field:baseAltitude}, adjusted {value:iimcAltitudeStep} feet for each subsequent chalk; base heading {field:baseHeading}, plus {value:iimcHeadingStep} degrees times your chalk number to the clear side; base airspeed {field:baseAirspeed}, less {value:iimcAirspeedStep} knots for subsequent chalks.
Contact the controlling agency. Recovery is {field:recovery}.

downedAircraft.title: Downed aircraft plan
downedAircraft.summary: Crew secures the site or moves within {value:downedMoveMeters} m and reports; wingman secures out to {value:downedSecurityMeters} m, establishes comms, calls for help and reports to higher.
script: Downed aircraft: the crew zeroizes as required, gives first aid, and secures the aircraft or moves within {value:downedMoveMeters} meters to a better place, then reports.

The wingman provides security out to {value:downedSecurityMeters} meters if the mission allows, establishes comms with the crew on the briefed frequency, calls for other aircraft and the ground commander, and reports to higher.

goAround.title: Go-around
goAround.summary: As a flight when lead or the AMC calls it, everyone following lead; single ship when one crew judges it unsafe, calling chalk and direction.
script: Go-around as a flight: lead or the AMC calls "flight, go-around" and everyone follows lead, {bind:stop.goAround}.
Single ship: call your chalk, go-around and direction, then land behind the last aircraft or in your position as briefed.
